verdict.rationale: Twenty ships an AI chatbot that answers natural-language questions about CRM data and AI agents that autonomously execute multi-step tasks (enrichment, queries) within a permission model, directly enabling natural-language operation of the product. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of the NL chatbot in real use, and clarity on how broadly NL commands can trigger actions beyond querying/enrichment (e.g., full CRUD via chat).
